description: Howmet Aerospace Inc. is a Delaware corporation with its principal office in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, that produces a range of high-performance multi-materials, highly engineered products and vertically integrated machined solutions for aero engines and airframe structures, ranging from investment castings, advanced coatings, seamless rings, forgings, titanium extrusions and titanium mill products to fasteners that hold aircraft together. Wingtip to wingtip, nose to tail, Howmet can produce more than 90 percent of all structural and rotating aero engine components, and its largest market is aerospace, which represented approximately 70 percent of company revenue in 2025.
